name: Infernal Mages

variantInfo.name: Infernal Mage
notes: Standard combat level 66 Infernal Mage (npc 443-447); the Slayer-task target requiring 45 Slayer.
60 Hitpoints, max hit 8, 4-tick Magic attack (magic level 75); Protect from Magic negates their attack completely.
Defence level 60 with all melee and ranged defensive bonuses 0 and +40 magic defence, so melee is the standard kill.
The superior variant is the Malevolent Mage.

locationComparison.name: Slayer Tower (first floor)
notes: Infernal Mages are found only in the Slayer Tower, in the north-east room on the first floor (one level above ground). The Wiki lists 15 spawn tiles.
A Slayer ring teleports to the entrance. Alternatives include fairy ring CKS south of the tower, Salve Graveyard Teleport, or Kharyrll teleport to Canifis, then running north-west.

Fenkenstrain's Castle Teleport followed by a run west, an Ectophial followed by a longer walk, or walking through Paterdomus are further alternatives. Shortest Path checks available transports and their unlocks.
Use the south-east stairs. The normal ground-floor route passes Banshees, so wear Earmuffs or a Slayer helmet while passing them; the eastern broken-window shortcut at 18 Agility avoids that route.

The 61 Agility spiked chain reaches the Aberrant spectre room instead. Wear a Nose peg or Slayer helmet if taking that route; 60 Slayer is needed to equip a Nose peg, not to use the stairs to Infernal Mages.
Cannons are prohibited throughout the Slayer Tower. The Infernal Mage page does not document a safespot; their Magic attacks can still reach ranged attackers.

taskNotes: Infernal Mages require 45 Slayer and Priest in Peril for Morytania access. Vannaka assigns 40-90 (weight 8); Mortimer assigns a base 35-50 (weight 10), before task modifiers. Each master also has their own access requirements.
Chaeldar stopped assigning Infernal Mages on 8 May 2024, and Duradel on 10 September 2015.

Infernal Mages have 60 Hitpoints, a max hit of 8 and a 4-tick Magic attack. Their Magic level is 75, Defence level 60, and defensive bonuses are 0 against melee/ranged and +40 against Magic. No elemental weakness is listed.
Protect from Magic negates their attacks. They are immune to weak burns.
The superior encounter is the Malevolent Mage; it is not a separately selectable repeatable setup.
No task extension unlock is listed. Mortimer can offer a quantity modifier.
Completed Morytania Diary tiers grant 2.5%, 5%, 7.5% or 10% bonus Slayer experience in the tower.
recommendedMethod: Melee Infernal Mages in the north-east room on the first floor of the Slayer Tower. Use your best owned melee equipment and a Slayer helmet or black mask on task. Protect from Magic (37 Prayer) blocks their magic attacks; bring prayer restoration and food. Cannons cannot be used in the tower.
